open_issues.title: Maintenance content-filters silently on explicit-content books
open_issues.summary: GMICloud content-filters maintenance turns to a zero-write no-op; fallback fix shipped but not airtight.

open_issues.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash tool-call JSON corruption, multi-provider
open_issues.summary: CoreWeave exclusion fixed that provider; StreamLake/Baidu/GMICloud still corrupt occasionally, guard catches it cleanly.

open_issues.title: WSS uvicorn worker died silently mid-turn
open_issues.summary: One worker of three died with no exception logged; orphaned turn lease left a conversation stuck ~15min.

open_issues.title: truncated_text on max_tokens mid-reply
open_issues.summary: By-design behavior ships cut-off prose rather than re-streaming; first time actually surfaced in a sweep.

open_issues.title: generate_report silently empty on unparseable JSON
open_issues.summary: Router demotes to Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite under latency pressure, which reliably corrupts report JSON.

open_issues.title: update_agent_usage_metrics_batch MySQL deadlock
open_issues.summary: No lock ordering across 17 agent-usage row updates per critique; low volume, kills the request when it hits.

open_issues.title: Review agents return malformed JSON — dominant error source
open_issues.summary: 250-345+/day baseline; root cause is the same Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite router-demotion as item 14.

open_issues.title: get_processed_sentence_by_number str/int TypeError
open_issues.summary: Model-supplied line_number as string crashes the whole critique request; shape-assumption bug family.

open_issues.title: Mass silent comment-drop on sentence-lookup miss
open_issues.summary: Same call site as item 15's crash but the graceful branch — 169/171 comments silently dropped in one incident.

open_issues.title: execute_llm_call crashes on list-shaped model output
open_issues.summary: result.get() assumes dict; model returning a JSON array kills the whole critique request.

open_issues.title: Closed-WebSocket ASGI send crash — 4 sites unguarded
open_issues.summary: PR #186 fixed the routing side-effect; comments/reports/versions/progress-message sends still unguarded.

open_issues.title: AsyncAdaptedQueuePool CancelledError on disconnect
open_issues.summary: Pool finalizer race on client disconnect, ~7% of disconnects; fix shape (log filter) confirmed via code, not shipped, still no user impact.

open_issues.title: Duplicate chapter-summary rows — reopened
open_issues.summary: UNIQUE constraint now live and correctly rejecting duplicates; occasional benign IntegrityError noise remains.

open_issues.title: annotate_chapter crashes on list-shaped model output
open_issues.summary: Same shape-assumption family as items 7/12/15, this call site not yet hardened.

open_issues.title: Knowledge-file create races background refresher
open_issues.summary: Concurrent kb_init bootstrap calls race harmlessly; all-or-nothing transaction, just log noise.

open_issues.title: Book deleted mid-maintenance → FK + StaleData tracebacks
open_issues.summary: Clean-fail race, widened blast radius seen 2026-08-10 to also hit agent_messages and comments inserts.

open_issues.title: Rewind to off-chain message (client temp IDs)
open_issues.summary: Frontend fires rewind on a stale client-side temp ID before the real ID lands; a handful/day, client-side root cause.

open_issues.title: Empty-stream rescue doesn't execute tool calls
open_issues.summary: Rescue re-stream is text-only, so a write-intent turn's rescue produces a non-committal reply instead of the write.

open_issues.title: Chapter-not-found soft-fail logged as ERROR
open_issues.summary: Expected write_document soft-fail miscategorized as ERROR; no user impact, pure logging-signal issue.

open_issues.title: write_document fails on knowledge_revisions FK — stale/nonexistent chapter_id
open_issues.summary: Conversation anchored to a chapter_id that doesn't exist; every write_document call fails its FK insert and the note is silently never saved.

open_issues.title: Book 116025 maintenance context exceeds every model's context window
open_issues.summary: 1.66M-token maintenance turn for a long-flagged pathological book exceeded every fleet model's context window, AllModelsFailed, zero KB update that cycle.

open_issues.title: safety.gpt_oss fail-open timeouts — Bedrock-side latency instability
open_issues.summary: CloudWatch confirms the Bedrock safety classifier's own latency spikes (up to 8s avg) while volume stays flat; 5s timeout + no retry means it fails open.

open_issues.title: Autosave lock pileup deadlock on update_all — reopened, residual after PR #110
open_issues.summary: PR #110's book-row-lock ordering fix mostly held; one isolated self-healing 1213 deadlock recurred on the same update_all path, no user-visible impact.

open_issues.title: Delete-account 100% fails for any user with a streak row
open_issues.summary: No ON DELETE CASCADE on user_streaks FK; guaranteed 500, complete block on account deletion.

open_issues.title: writers_dashboard.py 404s re-served as 500s
open_issues.summary: 6 sites' broad except-Exception re-catches Flask's own abort(404), serving a 500 to the client instead.

open_issues.title: Over-length book title crashes PUT/POST 500
open_issues.summary: No maxLength validation on title; DB column overflow raises a raw DataError instead of a clean 400.

open_issues.title: subscriptions.py TypeError → 500, self-healing
open_issues.summary: Root-caused to a stale pinned quarkle-monitoring dependency (0.1.11); fix is a version bump, not yet shipped.

open_issues.title: Request-Line-too-large from unbatched comment-ID query string
open_issues.summary: Frontend batching fix (PR #352) merged; deploy not independently confirmed live.

open_issues.title: Null/malformed body from client teardown race
open_issues.summary: Frontend sends a null payload mid-disconnect on 3 endpoints; validation correctly rejects it, client-side root cause.

open_issues.title: Bulk chat-cascade DELETE lock-wait timeout
open_issues.summary: ORM row-by-row cascade delete on chats is lock-heavy; overlapping concurrent deletes produce a spurious 500.

open_issues.title: track_chapter_word_counts FK violation on deleted chapters
open_issues.summary: Job queues work against a chapter that gets deleted before it runs; unclear if the retry wrapper is bounded.
